title: Google/GitHub sign-in from the desktop app returns to the app, and Approve on /signin works in a real browser (lane rounds included)
steps: S1: boot this checkout's tracy-web (memory store, console mail) on a free port; Chrome via chrome-watch plays the person's browser.
S2: open a lane round, sign in with an email code on /signin?n=, press Approve.

S3: open a desktop round (purpose desktop), approve it in the browser, redeem POST /auth/link/:nonce/session with the app's headers; probe a missing Origin, a wrong secret, a lane round at /session, and a second redeem.
S4: open another desktop round and press Deny.
expect: The /signin page sends Referrer-Policy: same-origin; the lane round becomes approved (it stayed pending under no-referrer, because Chrome sends Origin: null on the form).
The approve page names Tracy Cowork for Mac and shows the same matchCode the app received; the round becomes approved.
Redeem: no Origin 403; wrong secret 404 and the round stays redeemable; a lane round 404; the right secret 204 with Set-Cookie tracy_sess naming the approved account; a second redeem 404.
Deny turns the round to denied.
